relations.text: 最大の顧客で、2025年の連結売上高の13%を占めた
relations.text_en: PACCAR is the largest customer, accounting for 13 percent of consolidated net sales in 2025

source.label: カミンズ 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: PACCAR is our largest customer, accounting for 13 percent of our consolidated net sales in 2025, 16 percent in 2024 and 16 percent in 2023.

relations.text: アクセレラ、ダイムラー・トラックと並び、バッテリー合弁会社の30%を保有している

source.label: カミンズ 10-K(2025年12月期)
source.quote: Accelera, Daimler Truck and US Holding LLC and PACCAR, Inc. each own 30 percent of the joint venture and have two board positions, while EVE Energy owns 10 percent and has one board position.
